decisive_items: Compound heterozygous variants in WDR19 gene
Dilatation of intrahepatic bile ducts in left liver lobe
short and broad metacarpals and phalanges
response.rationale: Biallelic WDR19 variants plus a multisystem ciliopathy pattern involving renal, hepatic, skeletal, and neurodevelopmental findings make WDR19-related disease the most diagnostic label; Senior-Loken, Nephronophthisis, Jeune, and Joubert explain only subsets and lack key confirmatory features.

rejected.why: Neonatal hypotonia and involuntary eye movements overlap, but MRI shows no molar-tooth sign and the multisystem renal/hepatic/skeletal phenotype is not primarily Joubert.
Metacarpal and bile duct findings suggest Jeune, but there is no explicit thoracic-pattern skeletal support, and WDR19 molecular diagnosis is the broader reproducible category.
Kidney failure and echogenic kidneys fit nephronophthisis, but this ignores the WDR19 mutation and systemic ciliary findings.
Renal failure with eye movements could evoke Senior-Loken, but retinal dystrophy is not confirmed and the hepatic/skeletal molecular WDR19 picture is more representative.
